ranking.reason: Off-by-one guard: coupon transition needs used >= 1 (used-1 state), but 'used > 1' wrongly forbids using exactly one coupon mid-path.
Start states with used >= 1 silently grant free coupons at start; if coupons only apply on entry, these zero-cost states skew the DP.
Reads used-1; correct only if callers guarantee used >= 1, otherwise index -1 wraps. Guard interplay masks this fragility.
Strict '<' means ties always take ordinary; harmless for cost, but could pick a parent inconsistent with intended coupon usage.
